faqItems.guestsDownloadQ: Do guests need to download anything?
faqItems.guestsDownloadA: No. Guests can join from the browser with the room link, so the room can start without an extra install step.
faqItems.whatGamesQ: What games can I play with friends on Movmash?
faqItems.whatGamesA: Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect 4 and a jigsaw puzzle you solve together, with more on the way. They all run in the browser inside your room, so nobody has to leave or install anything.
faqItems.gamesFreeA: Yes. Every game is on the free plan. Paid plans add room size, watch time, video calls and screen-share quality — they do not unlock games.
faqItems.friendsAccountQ: Do my friends need to create an account?
faqItems.friendsAccountA: Friends can join and watch without creating an account. Creating a room or being the host requires signing in with Google for a seamless experience.
faqItems.platformsQ: What platforms can I watch together?
faqItems.platformsA: Movmash supports YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, Dailymotion, HLS streams, and more. You can also share your screen to watch premium streaming services or any other platform together.
faqItems.screenShareA: In Stream mode you can share your browser tab, an application window, or your entire screen. For the best audio quality we recommend sharing a browser tab — everyone in the room sees and hears exactly what you share.
faqItems.localFilesQ: Can I watch local video files with friends?
faqItems.localFilesA: Absolutely. In Stream mode you can play video files from your computer to everyone in the room. Your files stay on your computer — we don't store them on our servers.
faqItems.participantLimitQ: Is there a limit on room participants?
faqItems.participantLimitA: Free rooms support up to 2 participants. Premium is built for larger rooms with more than 50 participants.
faqItems.privacyQ: Is my data private and secure?
faqItems.privacyA: Yes. Rooms are private by default — only people with the room link can join. We don't store your video files, and all communications are encrypted.
